title: Leo Gottlieb Professor of Law
bio: Christine Desan is the Leo Gottlieb Professor of Law. She teaches about the political economy of capitalism, the constitutional law of money, the international monetary system, constitutional history, and legal theory. She is the winner of the 2024 Sacks-Freund Award for Teaching Excellence at Harvard Law School. Her book, Making Money: Coin, Currency, and the […]
